title: Every live session gets a silence measure, with or without a backlog item
goal: kbmon's sessions panel gives each live Claude Code session of the clone a silent_s (the seconds since the newest write to its transcript), not only working runs in the coord panel; the metrics export carries it and the alert rules file in otel/ alerts on a session silent past a threshold it names; the panel's text names a silent session by its line, as it does now.

run: import json,subprocess as s,sys;p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','sessions'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,check=True);d=json.loads(p.stdout);t=json.dumps(d['panels']);print(t[:400]);sys.exit(0 if 'silent_s' in t else 1)
